title: Graduated categories of presheaves
summary: We study conditions on a small category $\mathcal{A}$ under which every finitely generated object of its presheaf category is finitely presentable. Example: this holds for a group $\mathcal{A}$ iff $\mathcal{A}$ is Noetherian. For ordinals $\mathcal{A}=α$ this holds iff $α\leq ω$, whereas this always holds for $\mathcal{A}=α^{op}$. Various important properties of set functors also apply to endofunctors on locally finitely presentable categories which are graduated.
